purpose: Sticky 67px site header: wordmark, primary nav (>=1080.02), right-hand CTAs and the <1080.02 drawer. Orients every page and carries the page's primary conversion CTA on product pages.

variants.signin-menu: Homepage, /plans, /enterprise: Contact sales + 'Sign in' product menu (route has no header option).
variants.product-ctas: /mail, /docs, /go, /agents: Contact sales + Log in + primaryCompact button labelled ctaLabel (route header.cta).

responsive.change: Wordmark + hamburger only; nav and CTAs move into the full-viewport <dialog> drawer.
Right CTAs appear (Contact sales + Sign in menu, or Contact sales + Log in + primaryCompact CTA).
Primary nav shown (ml 32, gap 8); hamburger hidden.
Content wrapper max width grows from 1280 to 1440 (--content-max); layout otherwise unchanged. Viewports above 1440 were not measured (CLONE_SPEC.md 14).

notes: Header background is 'neutral-5' only on /go (route header.bg '#f7f5f2', which also paints <main> and the drawer); everywhere else 'white'.
Nav labels and dropdown menus are global (src/data/content.js), not per-page content, so they are not part of the PageSpec.
